prompt: The integrators are filing tickets against our INI reader and I can finally reproduce some of it: quoted values that mention ; or # come back cut short or make the read fail outright, settings that wrap onto a second line lose everything after the wrap, and when a file sets the same key twice we keep the wrong one. Saving is just as unreliable - the writer puts quotes around values that were fine bare and loses padding and line breaks that mattered, so a load-then-save no longer reproduces the input. The agreed rules are in docs/dialect.md; the tests under test/ are the reproductions we managed to write, not the whole acceptance criteria.
